def find_max_goal_difference(T, test_cases):
    results = []
    for case in test_cases:
        N = case[0]
        goals = case[1]
        if N < 2:
            results.append("UNFIT")
            continue
        max_diff = 0
        min_goal = goals[0]
        for i in range(1, N):
            max_diff = max(max_diff, goals[i] - min_goal)
            min_goal = min(min_goal, goals[i])
        if max_diff > 0:
            results.append(max_diff)
        else:
            results.append("UNFIT")
    return results
